description: Department of Local Government, Norhern Province - The meeting for the election to fill the vacancy of Chairman of Karainager Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election to fill the vacancy of Chairman of a local authority (Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha). It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act and deals with electoral processes at the local government level, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette.
